resources.string: Project A.S.S.E.S.S. turns your phone into a bubble-sheet scanner and grader — no separate scanner hardware, no backend server for scanning or grading. Generate a printable answer sheet, build an answer key by tapping bubbles, then scan filled sheets with the camera for instant, color-coded results.\n\nThe app processes assessment data locally; a project-specific update channel has not yet been configured.
